scope: existing files only; no new ingest, source tuning, participant selection or m/e remediation prerequisite

E1.question: How do local fitted Jacobian spectral growth and Euclidean reactivity associate descriptively with recorded sleep labels?
E1.mapping: Use each Jacobian centers array as explicit epoch array positions, validate unique integer bounds, map to actual epoch_id/time/label; never zip to all epochs or bridge nonconsecutive centers.
E1.support: fixed producer estimator, finite metric/J, explicit reader status; labeled center is not full neighborhood/filter containment
E1.units: inverse derivative time unit; verify derivative dt in seconds before labeling figure s^-1; no conversion inferred from generic attrs
E1.metric_dependence: numerical abscissa and reactivity depend on chart metric; 3D/9D and recording references remain separate

E2.question: How do the magnitude and anisotropy of existing raw chart increment covariance associate descriptively with query labels?
E2.mapping: exact query epoch_id/time/label alignment from canonical diffusion reader; preserve producer valid/support_count and PSD-floor flags
E2.estimator: unchanged global state-neighborhood covariance divided by nominal dt; no per-stage neighborhood, residualization or refit

units.D_total: recording-relative coordinate squared / second at nominal dt30s

E2.aliases: do not count diffusion_total/effective_dimension/concentration as additional endpoints

shared_summaries.code8: separate unknown-source category excluded from known-stage summaries; retain count
shared_summaries.denominators: each recording/representation/metric separately: stored rows, mapped rows, finite rows, producer support/validity and used rows
shared_summaries.contrast: N2 median minus Wake median, for every planned endpoint separately; absent/unsupported group -> null; no selection on observed sign
shared_summaries.cross_participant: separate relative-reference descriptions, not calibrated effect sizes; no pooling/pvalues/population claims
figures: Jacobian alpha/omega stage distributions in separate3D9D panels plus actual-center timeline without joining gaps
3D diffusion D_total/d_diff/c_diff by query label with support and floor indicators

E3.reference_smoke_spec: train increment indices0:600, evaluation700:800, k32,min_support12,embargo60s, estimatorslocal_mean/local_linear; raw30s supports; this is engineering smoke only
